title: Claude Sheets Beta (2026): Check an AI Total, Explained Slowly
description:
Claude Sheets beta, explained slowly in under a minute through a math teacher's "show your work": since November 10, 2026, on paid plans, Claude Sheets is a spreadsheet inside Claude where you and Claude edit the same cells.
Anthropic says formulas stay in the cells, so you can see and check how each number was calculated; Claude's edits are outlined as they land, and when Claude finishes, a card can undo only that change; it goes a few seconds after you're back in the sheet, or as soon as you work in the cells, and after that version history restores an earlier version, which also removes edits made after it.
The Claude Help Center says it's on by default on Team plans, and on Enterprise plans it's off by default until it's turned on in Organization settings > Artifacts.

Try Claude: https://claude.ai

The story: many math teachers ask their students to show their work, and showing work can help you figure out where you made a mistake (Pima County Public Library). The analogy is for our example only, not a claim about what Claude's chat can write: in our example, the budget pasted from chat into another tool held plain text, so our 3 pasted totals were like answers alone, and checking one meant redoing the sum.

Our example, not Anthropic's numbers: a hiring budget by team and quarter, 3 teams x 4 quarters, with 3 team totals. The prompt "Make a hiring budget by team and quarter." is Anthropic's example; the 3 totals and "ALL 3" are ours. The sources do not say Claude writes all numbers as formulas; in the beta, totals can be formulas you check, and a formula shows how a number was calculated, not that it is right.

What's new, in the beta on paid plans. Anthropic's help page: "A sheet is an artifact that you and Claude edit in the same cells. Claude can add tabs, write formulas that work across tabs, apply formatting and conditional formatting, and add dropdowns, checkboxes, and charts." "Formulas stay in the cells, so you can see and check how each number was calculated." "When Claude changes a sheet, each edit is outlined as it lands, so you can see what changed."

Undo: "When Claude finishes, a card says what Claude updated. If it shows “Undo,” select it to take back only that change. The card goes away a few seconds after you’re back in the sheet, or as soon as you work in the cells. After that, use Version history to restore an earlier version, which also removes edits made after it."

Limits: "For now, sheets have simple spreadsheet functionality, but we are working on adding more." "Claude Sheets is in beta and covers common spreadsheet work." Not supported: "Macros, VBA, Power Query, DAX, and print layout." "Sheets can’t pull live data from connected apps" "Claude Sheets counts toward your plan’s usage limits, like the rest of your work with Claude."

Sources:
- Anthropic (claude.com), "Introducing Claude Whiteboards, Claude Sheets, and Claude Data", November 10, 2026, Product updates: https://claude.com/resources/articles/sheets-whiteboards-data
